written.headline: Nvidia reportedly funded AI startups to absorb excess GPU supply
written.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly financed AI startups and cloud providers to absorb excess semiconductor shipments. The financing strategy aimed to manage over-ordered TSMC silicon and maintain GPU pricing.

written.headline: WhiteMatter raises $20 million Series A for AI agent governance platform
written.summary: Cybersecurity startup WhiteMatter raised a $20 million Series A funding round led by Blumberg Capital, bringing its total funding to $24 million. The company builds platform governance and "guardian" agents to oversee AI agent file access, software use, and decision-making.

written.headline: Sam Bankman-Fried misses out on Anthropic IPO windfall
written.summary: An analysis shows that Sam Bankman-Fried's 2021 investment of $500M in Anthropic would be worth approximately $37B if the company lists at a $1.5T valuation. However, the jailed cryptocurrency mogul relinquished his stake in 2024 for about $1.3B.
